title: 整流电压的 RC 滤波：纹波有多大？
statement: 12 V、50 Hz 的交流电经全波整流得到 u = 12√2 |cos(100πt)| V（基波频率 f_1 = 100 Hz，ω_1 = 200π rad/s），其傅里叶级数为
u = \frac{2U_m}{π} + \frac{4U_m}{π}(\frac{1}{3}cos ω_{1}t − \frac{1}{15}cos 2ω_{1}t + …)，U_m = 12√2 V（计算取到 19 次谐波）。
u 经 R = 20 Ω、C = 1000 µF 组成的 RC 滤波器加到负载 R_L = 200 Ω 上。求输出电压 u_o 的直流分量、100 Hz 纹波分量（有效值）和纹波系数 U_o1/U_o0。

questions.ask: 整流电压 u 的 100 Hz 分量有效值 U_1 = ?
u_o 的 100 Hz 纹波有效值 U_o1 = ?
纹波系数 U_o1/U_o0 约为多少？
choiceExplain: 这比实际小了 10 倍；检查 X_C 的计算（ω_1 = 2π × 100 rad/s）。
5.8% 是用纹波的幅值 0.571 V 除以直流分量；纹波系数用有效值。

hints: 按谐波分别计算：直流时电容开路；k 次谐波时电容的容抗是 1/(kω_{1}C)。
100 Hz 时 X_C = 1/(2π × 100 × 1000×10⁻⁶) ≈ 1.6 Ω，远小于 R_L：R_L 与 C 并联后几乎就是 C。
纹波分量的输出 ≈ 输入 × X_C/√(R² + X_C²)；有效值把各分量平方相加再开方。
solution: **检查（近似）：** X_C ≪ R、R_L 时 U_o1 ≈ U_1·X_C/R = 5.093 × 1.592/20 = 0.405 V，与第 2 步只差 0.4%。这个近似也说明：纹波与 C 成反比。

en.title: RC filtering of a rectified voltage: how large is the ripple?
statement: 12 V, 50 Hz AC is full-wave rectified to u = 12√2 |cos(100πt)| V (fundamental f_1 = 100 Hz, ω_1 = 200π rad/s), whose Fourier series is
u = \frac{2U_m}{π} + \frac{4U_m}{π}(\frac{1}{3}cos ω_{1}t − \frac{1}{15}cos 2ω_{1}t + …), U_m = 12√2 V (harmonics up to the 19th are kept).
u feeds a load R_L = 200 Ω through an RC filter R = 20 Ω, C = 1000 µF. Find the DC component of the output u_o, its 100 Hz ripple (rms) and the ripple factor U_o1/U_o0.
hints: Work harmonic by harmonic: at DC the capacitor is open; at harmonic k its reactance is 1/(kω_{1}C).
At 100 Hz X_C = 1/(2π × 100 × 1000×10⁻⁶) ≈ 1.6 Ω, far below R_L: R_L in parallel with C is practically just C.
The ripple at the output ≈ input × X_C/√(R² + X_C²); for the rms value add the squares of the components and take the root.
solution: **4. rms value:** the 200 Hz component is smaller still (1.019 V in, about 0.040 V out), U_o = √(9.822² + 0.4037² + 0.040² + …) = **9.830 V**.
**Check (approximation):** with X_C ≪ R, R_L, U_o1 ≈ U_1·X_C/R = 5.093 × 1.592/20 = 0.405 V, within 0.4 % of step 2. The approximation also shows that the ripple is inversely proportional to C.

questions.explain: At DC the capacitor is open: U_o0 = \frac{2U_m}{π}·\frac{R_L}{R + R_L} = 10.80 × 200/220 = 9.822 V.

questions.ask: rms value of the 100 Hz component of the rectified voltage u, U_1 = ?
rms value of the 100 Hz ripple of u_o, U_o1 = ?
The ripple factor U_o1/U_o0 is about
choiceExplain: Ten times too small; check X_C (ω_1 = 2π × 100 rad/s).
5.8 % divides the ripple amplitude 0.571 V by the DC component; the ripple factor uses the rms value.
questions.explain: U_o1/U_o0 = 0.4037/9.822 ≈ 4.1 %. Before filtering U_1/U_0 = 5.093/10.80 = 47 %: the capacitor cuts the ripple about 11 times.
U_o = √(U_o0² + U_o1² + U_o2² + …) = √(9.822² + 0.4037² + 0.0405² + …) ≈ 9.830 V, almost the DC component.
